rules.name: Church of the Eternal Veil
rules.equip: Ritual goods, Mystic instruments, contemplative tools
rules.benefit: Recognized by Veil-sensitive communities. Advantage on rolls involving Mystic sites or sacred substrate.
rules.obligation: Ritual attendance + contemplative practice + tithes of time or substance.

rules.name: Explorers' Guild
rules.equip: Exploration gear, Veil-route data, survey instruments
rules.benefit: Access to classified Veil-route data. Advantage on rolls to identify unexplored regions or anomalies.
rules.obligation: Quarterly survey reports + mentorship of junior members.

rules.name: Free Fleet
rules.equip: Ship parts, salvage gear, survival kit
rules.benefit: Owed favors across Free Fleet docks. Advantage on rolls to find ships, berths, or crew in any port.
rules.obligation: Dock fees + mutual-aid obligations. Honor signed contracts.

rules.name: House Amaranth
rules.equip: Books, archives, research materials, esoteric instruments
rules.benefit: Access to restricted archives. Advantage on Research rolls drawing on House Amaranth resources.
rules.obligation: Annual tithe. Preserve and share knowledge.

rules.name: House Joric
rules.equip: Defensive equipment, security tech, contract paperwork
rules.benefit: Legal protection in most jurisdictions. Advantage on rolls to obtain security clearances or contracts.
rules.obligation: Annual tithe + contract justification for any violence.

rules.name: House Kurogane
rules.benefit: Access to cutting-edge tech and augmentations. Advantage on rolls to source or repair advanced equipment.
rules.obligation: Annual tithe + ceremonial appearances. Oppose the heresy of Naturalism.

rules.name: House Solari
rules.equip: Ceremonial items, fine goods, social access tokens
rules.benefit: Starting Reputation +3 with Imperial institutions. Invitations to high-society functions.
rules.obligation: Tithe + public alignment. Attend restoration-themed events.

rules.name: House Valerius
rules.equip: Commercial goods, Pearl-related items, financial instruments
rules.benefit: Advantage on all financial and commercial negotiations. Access to Pearl markets at preferred rates.
rules.obligation: Annual tithe. Work through Valerius commercial channels.

rules.name: House Volkov
rules.benefit: Equipment from Volkov's domain up to a Tier above your Wealth Tier. Advantage on rolls to acquire military intel.
rules.obligation: Annual tithe + service obligations. Cannot break sworn oaths.

rules.name: Independent
rules.benefit: No dues or obligations. You gain a Standing Pool of 3 points, redeemable once per session as a general social resource.
rules.obligation: None formal — but no formal protection either.

rules.name: Solara Compact
rules.equip: Core-Worlds equipment, ceremonial goods, restoration tools
rules.benefit: Advantage on diplomatic rolls with Imperial-adjacent factions. Access to restoration project resources.
rules.obligation: Political contributions. Attend restoration events. Maintain public alignment.

rules.name: Stellar Commerce Guild
rules.equip: Commercial goods, market data, trade credentials
rules.benefit: Recognized as a licensed trader in all major ports. Advantage on rolls to source or sell any commodity.
rules.obligation: Commission on major transactions. Trade through Guild channels.

rules.name: House Kaelen
rules.equip: Diplomatic credentials, translation systems, legal archives, nonlethal sidearms, restraint gear, field medical supplies, surveillance countermeasures
rules.benefit: Within a recognized Kaelen charter or mixed-jurisdiction dispute, gain Advantage on a Presence Roll to mediate or a Knowledge Roll to interpret treaty law, jurisdiction, protected status, or formal obligations.
rules.call: Once per session, request plausible Kaelen support: safe conduct, an emergency neutral hearing, sealed treaty records, a cultural liaison, a limited escort, or provisional protection.
rules.obligation: Accept lawful rotation, preserve public neutrality, document significant political and security information, and protect chartered vulnerable populations.
